Name: Crows Pet Beds - AT
Author: CrowChilde
Description:
I'm gonna be real. I made this mod just for me and decided to put it up in case other people wanted to add the textures I did for the pet bed into their own game. I'll probably go back and add more later, but for now, here are two textures. Maybe if I get good enough, I'll create my own textures from scratch, but for now, this is fine!

It's meant to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10478]DGA Pet Bed[/url] mod AND [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10462]Custom Pet Beds mod[/url]. You will need both in order for this mod to work! I mean. Obviously, right?

Credits:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]Aedenthorn[/url] for their Pet Bed mods!
